item.title: Re: A statue that moves through the darkness (seeking greenlights)
item.content:encoded:
Hey there ragewhatle17, I'll be critting your idea today!
This is going to be a brief crit, so here goes:

I'm going to stop you right here and tell you SCP-173 did it better. This is a statue that kills people when it can't be observed (i.e lack of visible light), and people will tear this apart for that reason if it ever ends up on-Site.
My advice? Don't continue with this idea, and I'd advise you to scrap any similar ideas you may have. As a general rule, statues that move when not looked at (or in this case, when not in an illuminated area) are a bad idea on this Site.
I'd recommend checking out the Guide Hub for some great essays to help you with future ideas.

That's it for my crit. Hope it helps!

item.title: A statue that moves through the darkness (seeking greenlights)
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional):

Page Layout (Optional):

Elevator Pitch:

  • An SCP that can disrupt electricity
  • An SCP that can only move around when light doesn't touch the SCP

Central Narrative: This SCP is a stone statue that dates from during the renaissance age. The stone statue is broken having no right elbow, no nose, and a broken hilt. The reason for this is probably old age.

The foundation went under investigation after a group of archeologists went missing somewhere in France. When the foundation located the SCP they found it inside a cave, the cave was decorated with marble columns, and torches were lit inside it. All electrical devices and electrical lights got disrupted and the foundation took the SCP within it, however, since the foundation found the SCP in the middle of the night 10 personnel were later killed trying to transport the statue. After the incident, the foundation decided to transport the SCP in a small container lit by the torches that were within the cave.

The foundation needs to use non-electrical light producers meaning they can't use lightbulbs, spotlights, flashlights to stop the SCP from moving and killing everyone. Only visible light can stop the SCP from moving such as sunlight, candlelight, and etc. The reason why this SCP can't move under light is unknown but there are two current theories.

The statue hasn't been in a brighter light other than the torches for a very long time.
The statue was made from a human, the statue's purpose is to be in the spotlight, to entertain and amaze humans. It's not supposed to move because that is not what they are supposed to do, only in the dark they are allowed to move.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: This SCP can disrupt electricity which renders light bulbs, flashlights, phones, and even clean energy useless. This makes the SCP harder to contain when light bulbs and spotlights aren't used against the SCP since lights immobilize the object. So the foundation has to use oil lamps, candles, and torches to keep the SCP from breach containment.

Additional Notes: I seek feedbacks and criticisms, thank you.
